item.title: Six AI Frontiers as Global Public Good
item.description: In my recent brief to the Philippines Ministry of Health on 10 June 2026, I mapped out the stake of evolving global AI surveillance landscape and Taiwan’s blueprint for an AI-first roadmap to health surveillance. For this post, I have highlighted six pivotal global advancements that are currently reshaping the field. Download my public-version deck here: AI-enabled Intelligent Transformation of International Outbreak Monitoring. By mid-2026, agentic and generative AI are no longer just buzzwords—they are actively deployed across global epidemic intelligence systems.
